title: ጠንካራዋ እናቴ
style: Cinematic realism, warm, emotional, nostalgic, authentic rural Ethiopian environment

purpose: To celebrate the strength, sacrifices, love, and contribution of rural Ethiopian mothers.
central_message: Rural mothers deserve to be seen, heard, respected, and celebrated for their hard work and contribution to their children's futures.

shots.narration: እኔን ለማሳደግና ለማስተማር፣ ያልወረደችው ቁልቁለት፣ ያልወጣችው ዳገት የለም።

shots.music_cue: Gradually building emotional instrumental music, suggesting determination and resilience.

shots.music_cue: Steady, dignified instrumental rhythm, expressing strength and persistence.
